notes.title: Update Version 0.0.29
notes.content:
[h2]Face and Body decorations[/h2]
New cosmetic decoration options for your character in the form of scars and tattoos. These unique markings can add a touch of personality and flair to your characters.

These scars will be randomly generated and placed on various parts of your character's body, adding a subtle hint of battle wear or adventure.
If you prefer more control over your character's appearance, you can also customize scars and tattoos in the customization panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/644d847f0ca7cf73c8360a74f251eb457fb81c99.png[/img]

[h2]Dual Wield[/h2]
Characters that wield two one-hand weapons in both hands will receive a temporary trait "dual wield". 

When the trait is active, your character has a 20% chance to perform a second free attack following their primary attack. This second attack can be of the same or lower AP cost as the initial attack.

Equipping two weapons with the same proficiency, will boost your dual attack chance to 40%, ensuring that your enemies will never have a moment of respite.

And for those truly dedicated to dual wield mastery, certain passive skills will further augment your dual attack rate.

[h2]Detail Panel[/h2]
With a simple right-click on any character, you'll gain access to a comprehensive view of their stats, traits, active skills, and active effects. This valuable tool will empower you to make informed decisions in the heat of battle, ensuring you utilize your characters' strengths to their fullest potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/b7d2421af4d1ba432f2320c782bb177fa202e804.png[/img]

[h2]Area of Effect[/h2]
In this update you have access to some passive skills, traits and weapons effect that cast an area of effect on the battlefield, with this change position your character on the field become even more important.

You can create a impenetrable defence line with the Shield Wall passive skill, but beware also some enemies get new skills, for example some undeads will have a poison miasma trait that will deal damage to characters standing to close to them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/07d8d28eda2b613c7f6c460db2a7eed27cc9fa78.png[/img]

[h2]Custom Battle[/h2]
If you prefer to just jump to action and play a fast battle with specific settings, or you want to try to play as factions that are unplayable on the normal campaign? 

Now you play a custom battle directly form the main screen, customize your battle settings, choose yours and enemy groups and start the battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/b3307f1f9ebad54bdb719399a3cefb139ed0c206.png[/img]

[h2]Auto Equip[/h2]
When your guild become quite big could be demanding to keep track of the inventory of each party and choose the best equip for your characters, the new "Auto Equip" feature could help you with that.

You can choose from a wide range of options like the role you would like to have for that character, which type of defence it should prioritize, which damage type should be focus in, then confirm your choices and let the game do the rest 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/ab5644bbdd1f1d997dbcde41985d3144d6425c69.gif[/img]

[h2]Battle preview and Auto Resolve[/h2]
With this update instead of going directly to the battlefield, when encountering an enemy party, you'll be presented with the Battle Preview Screen, offering a detailed breakdown of both your and their party composition.

You'll receive an assessment of your chances of victory. This percentage-based indicator will help you gauge the difficulty of the upcoming encounter

The Battle Preview Screen presents you with two distinct options for approaching the battle: manual or automatic resolve. Choose manual combat to exercise full control over your actions and strategies. For those seeking a quicker resolution, automatic resolve can handle the combat mechanics and skip directly to the result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/9126387d538d84cffdf251a5c4d6526df29dafd9.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced arrow base count for quivers from 10 to 6, should address the issue of ranged class being too powerfull
[*] New traits system, now support temporary traits when some conditions are met (like dual wielding)
[*] Added face and body decorations selection on character customization panel
[*] Add an alert icon for lack of ammo or wrong ammo type in the inventory screen
[*] Added images for status effects
[*] Battle result screen will also display enemy party result statistics
[*] Added various new armors
[*] Added 4 new weapons, "Handgun", "Steppe Pike", "Yari", "Steppe Sword"
[*] New helmets "Sallet" basic and variants
[*] Added various new light and heavy helmets
[*] Removed the axe_throw skill from the hatchet
[*] Added weapon affix can now grant passive skills too
[*] Add new buttons under the end turn NPC factions to change the turn speed (normal and fast)
[*] Added the possibility to attack NPC Kingdom watchmen, with an immediate relationship malus of -50 (they become aggresive)
[*] Bandits party will attack you if they think they are stronger than your parties
[*] Kingdom watchmen will attack player parties if the relationship is equal or lower than -50
[*] Added custom group generation for caravans, now they will show more variations on their equippment and can be specific for each race
[*] Double the gold reward for quests
[*] Added the possibility for friendly party to pass between each other without having to go over the side
[/list]

Small bugs fix:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash happening when the player try to reach the Settings
[*] Fixed AI pathfinding in combat get stuck in some cases
[*] Fixed a bug that was starting more than one turn after the turnlist was over while on auto combat
[*] Fixed the range of some bow skills
[*] Fixed a dark elf bug on the customization panel not showing the corrent hair color index
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent the hand to be shown when the shield HP were at 0
[*] Fixed a bug that was keeping enabled the actions buttons when the player would move more than one cell in combat
[*] Fixed a bug that save kingdom color on the texture cache, changing the color of other items too
[*] Fixed a bug on morale modifiers
[*] Fix a bug for duplicated resource on the market
[*] Fixed the trade price change so it never go under -65% or over 65% the base item value
[*] Fixed guild prestige not updating correctly when loading a save game
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 0.0.28
notes.content:
[h2]Gloves & Gauntlets[/h2]
Following the last update that introduced visible hands for characters, now it is available a new equipment slot "gloves", now you will be able to customize even more your character loadout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/290227eafe0b6218dfbeaefc97a0c65b458f67cf.png[/img]

[h2]New Weapon Javelin[/h2]
A new weapon was added to the game in this update the [b]Javelin[/b], it is a polearm type weapon with a custom skill tree branch on that category, it can be used like a spear for melee attacks, or with the addition of the javelin bundle (a quiver type equipment), it also can be used as a ranged weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/fdb4e5a559b3105f0263b368db0082ebd4f5c922.gif[/img]

[h2]Biome Specific Enemy Groups[/h2]
With this update will be possible for the same enemy party to have different composition based on where it was created.
Now you will see different types of bandits if their lairs is on a cold region, a temperated or an arid one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/e49ed14b70bda3cbd7c6414f8aeb7b6c4f96c2ae.png[/img]

[h2]Market UI Improvement[/h2]
The market UI was improved, now it will display a summary of resource/items/members of the selected party or guild, in this way should be easier to look at what your party need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/7a898a36e36e1f4b559495c48d087295d47f7bb9.png[/img]

In addition another economics updated was implemented, now the selling values of items on the marketplace will be reduced based on its current durability left, it means an item at half durability will sell for half the base value.

[h2]Battle Results Details[/h2]
With this update, on the battle result screen, will be displayed also the total damage dealt to enemies and the total damage received, when the mouse is over one of the two it will display a tooltip with the breakdown of damage done on different layers. 

Now it will be easier to see how it character perform in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/b1ebae16ade361d7eee94b741fcf23336d7dd39b.png[/img]

[h2]Settlements Merchants and Militia[/h2]
In this update it was changed how settlements handle the creations of merchants caravan they send to other settlements, now they are no more limited to one active caravan each, but this limit will change depending on the settlement size (up to 3 for capital settlements), this should improve the resource flow between each others.

In addition to merchants, now big cities or capital cities ì, can spawn militia party that patrol the settlement area of influence and hunt bandits parties it can spot.
Right now it is not possible to interact with them, but in future updates the interactions with the player will be expanded (for example they will attack the player too, if the relationship with the kingdom is too low) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/4d97b91ed4a05dddd28a4bea0fc334c04f281363.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] New specific traits for goblins and undeads
[*] 3 New heavy helmets
[*] Changed from left click to right click to select the destination of a party movement on the world map
[*] Now when saving the game, the current position of the map will be recorded, and be the same one when loading
[*] Add a counter near the skill panel title on the inventory screen to show how many skills are available for the current selected character
[*] Now is possible to move more than one tile at time in combat, it will also display how many AP are left after moving to the specific tile
[*] Decreased the tooltip show delay from 1s to 0,5s
[/list]

Small bugs fix:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that keep showing a destroyed shield while in combat
[*] Fixed the turorial for the party view, craft panel and city info panel
[*] Fixed a bug that show again destroyed party and layer on loading a saved game
[*] Fixed a bug on the cultists quest not proceding after the first choice
[*] Fixed a bug that not show the correct equip position after the first turn of combat
[*] Fixed some race classes with outdated attributes
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent the AI to check skill cooldown before using it
[*] Fixed some UI part of the recruit list overlapping
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Combat Preview[/h2]
While in combat now there will displayed a new combat preview screen, that will show you the expected damage, the chance to hit and the chance enemy equipment will block your attack.

This should make ti more clear to the player how the game calculate the chance for an attack to be blocked by the amor or hit directly the Hit Points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44029398/915346f78acae40c263781d16df556b89ad98243.png[/img]

[h2]New Playable Faction[/h2]
Added a new playable faction [b]Dark Elves[/b], they are similiar to the already present Elf, but they will not be present on the map with settlements (as they are more nomadic), they will still show up in recruitment list in other faction settlements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44029398/0273234c8c433760a37dd498e8461083f1dc4261.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] All characters now will show their hands, gloves and gauntles will be added in future patches as new armors
[*] Expanded the settlement rumors, with new rumors, all linked to the specific settlement current condition, some of them will also trigger a quest
[*] Added new quests to settlement agent pool: 
[olist]
[*] Salvaging from the battlefield
[*] Investigate the Forest Ambush
[*] Unveiling Shadows
[/olist]
[/list]

Small bugs fix:

[list]
[*] Added the "-" symbol in front of damage popup in combat to make it more clear
[*] Fixed a bug that could would make your party move if selected while pressing some part of the UI 
[*] Fixed a bug that spawn quest locations on water
[*] Fixed a bug that in same case would prevent the enemy character to pass the turn 
[*] Fixed the end turn tooltip not showing in combat
[*] Fixed the recruit list background being too long and not getting truncate by the scroll
[*] Fixed the quest complete dialog being displayed over the event before closing it
[*] Fixed Market screen closing when pressed the "trade" button
[*] Fixed AI target system that in some case would make the AI pass the turn without actions
[*] Fixed the party inventory screen not updating the inventory number in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Advance Settings[/h2]
We added the possibility to futher tailor your expirience in the game, with the new advanced settings you can choose if you want small parties and fast skirmish or bigger battlefield with bigger parties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/f3d888edd01fb63eebcaab0b3c8f95200bb0ccae.png[/img]

You can change the default setting for :
[list]
[*] Max characters in combat
[*] The size of the battlefield grid
[*] How many party you can have on the map at the same time
[*] How many party member each party can have
[*] How many skills a character can equip at once
[*] How many AP the character will have each turn in combat
[*] The chance for a random travel event to trigger in the world map
[/list]

[h2]Trade Panel[/h2]
Added a button to buy all the current stock present on the local market. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/98b5d2800cea595ff1ac8b4ee9567b0f9a2f08d6.png[/img]

[h2]Movement Planning[/h2]
Now is possible to set a destination for the current selected party outside of its current movement range, it will travel automatically toward the destionation the next turns if the destination doesn't change.

Also enable the right mouse click button to hide the current party movement range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/a75550d4715dbb4d99892e925942c0b06ab6287d.png[/img]

New Feature
[list]
[*] Now the player can move the world map also using the mouse drag
[/list]

Small bugs fix:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent the player to complete a trade on the market
[*] Fixed a bug that made the player gain or lose money if trading between party and guild
[*] Fixed a bug that spawn the location for a quest in the bottom corner of the map
[*] Fixed a bug that show active quest of another campaign, if you go to the menu and immediatly start another one
[*] Fixed a bug that display the wrong Prestige value when starting a new campaign
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent you to load the game from the main menu in some cases
[*] Fixed a bug that count the guild money two times when loading
[/list]




Join the Discord server today! https://discord.com/invite/VZqPD4aZQA

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]More Equipment Info[/h2]
We received feedbacks that was not clear how much and how the equipment repair work, now equipment current status will be displayed with a percentage directly on the inventory screen so you are not forced to use only the tooltips anymore, additionaly the tooltips will display how many turns it takes for the item to be fully repaired in case the Party have enough food for the turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/5baf8f2c9ce2c99ab74534a2e5df5e1e7a82bbd9.png[/img]

[h2]Second set of weapons[/h2]
Given the limited number of party members you can bring to the fight and to let the player experience with more possibile combinations, we add the possibility to equip a second set of weapons for each characters that could be switch during combat at the cost of some AP (the initiative malus of the second set will always apply), useful especially for ranged characters after they empty their quiver or to adapt to the enemies resistance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/8414bc9e484add693bd00809a1f6eeac431685fe.png[/img]

[h2]Trade Panel[/h2]
The trade panel was revised, it was changed the how it show the items that would be sold or bought, now instead on going to the other list, they stay in the same and a more clear arrow button will let you choose how many of them to sell or buy.
Additionaly it was added a filter for both list in the trade panel to help the player find the items they are searching for. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/8dfdbdcfdd6fb95c1a1455bc935947369960843e.png[/img]

[h2]Rumors[/h2]
To help players stay update with what happen in settlements, a new rumors system was added for settlements they have a guild branch build, every turn there is chance new entries will be added to the list, at the moment is limited to:
[list]
[*] Increase/decrease of local market prices
[*] Spawn of new bandit lairs near the current location
[*] Attack of merchant caravans near the current location
[*] Change of the local recruit lists due to war start/end
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281848/bcecf33f168befec780c523186324292c0d0096e.png[/img]

[h2]Economy[/h2]
A simple supply/demand system introduced to make the global economy a little bit more dynamic, now resource price will increase in settlements based on local craftmen demand (for example a settlement that produce woods, will probably require ores), equipment also could change their market price based on current world events like wars.





Join the Discord server today! https://discord.com/invite/VZqPD4aZQA
